subject: KestrelPay enablement — console + API deep-dive
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@kestrelpay.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference>, onboarding@kestrelpay.com
Cc: Sana Iqbal <sana@kestrelpay.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Sep 2024 15:23:00 -0400
Subject: KestrelPay enablement — console + API deep-dive

Hi Sofia,

We're ready to kick off enablement for KestrelPay next week. Main goals: console walkthrough for platform admins, API enablement for our engineering team, and a short SSO/keys run-through so we can connect to staging.

Ideal format for us would be two half-day sessions (morning EU time) to split the console topics from the hands-on API lab. Our engineering lead and two backend devs will attend the API session; product andops will join the console walkthrough.

Can Redwood run a combined console + API deep-dive and propose 2 possible date pairs? Also let us know any preflight items we should take care of (credentials, IP allowlist, example data).

Thanks — appreciate a quick turn on options.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations | KestrelPay
liam.oconnor@kestrelpay.com
+44 7700 900123
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@kestrelpay.com>, Sana Iqbal <sana@kestrelpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 9 Sep 2024 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: KestrelPay enablement — console + API deep-dive

Hi Liam — thanks for the note, we'd be happy to run this.

Proposed blocks (EU morning):
- Option A: Wed 18 Sep 09:00–13:00 BST (console 09:00–11:00, API lab 11:30–13:00)
- Option B: Thu 19 Sep 09:00–13:00 BST (console 09:00–11:00, API lab 11:30–13:00)

Logistics / preflight items we need from you:
- Names and roles of attendees (for role-based demos and breakout labs)
- Access: staging API key (or a service account token) and list of public IPs to allow for the lab (if you run IP restrictions)
- SSO metadata if you want us to demo SAML earlier in the console walkthrough

I'm looping in Ben (SE) for the API lab and Camila (Enablement) for scheduling and materials. I'm attaching a short preflight checklist and the API playbook — please review and let us know which option works.

Warmly,
Sofia Ivanova
Enablement Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference
Attach: KestrelPay_preflight_checklist.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Sep 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: KestrelPay enablement — console + API deep-dive

On Mon, Sep 9, 2024 at 6:05 PM Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference> wrote:
> I'm looping in Ben (SE) for the API lab and Camila (Enablement) for scheduling and materials.

Thanks Sofia — happy to lead the API hands-on. A few quick notes from the SE side:
- We'll split the API time into a 30–45 minute walkthrough (endpoints, batching, embeddings) and a 60–75 minute lab where your devs run through example calls against staging.
- For the lab we'll provide a short token template; if you can't provide a staging key we can use temporary tokens but we'll need an IP allowlist or VPN tunnel for security.
- If you want to include quantization/latency tuning discussion, flag that up front and we'll add 15 minutes.

Attachment: enablement_lab_token_template.txt (small text stub with token naming convention).

Please send attendee names and their GitHub/Slack handles if you want hands-on pairing.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@kestrelpay.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Sep 2024 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: KestrelPay enablement — console + API deep-dive

Hi Liam — looping in materials and a provisional calendar invite.

I've created a provisional 2-block schedule and shared a Google Calendar event here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123_kestrelpay_enablement

Provisional schedule (BST):
- Day 1 (Console): 09:00–11:00 BST 
  - Admin console walkthrough, SSO demo (if you supply metadata ahead of time), runbook handoff
- Day 2 (API lab): 09:00–13:00 BST
  - 09:00–09:45 API overview + best practices
  - 10:00–12:00 Hands-on lab (pairing with Redwood SEs)
  - 12:00–13:00 Q&A and next steps (rollout plan)

Attachments uploaded to the shared drive: KestrelPay_preflight_checklist.pdf, API_onboarding_playbook_v1.1.pdf.

Quick asks from our ops team:
- Confirm final attendee list by EOD Tue 17 Sep (names + emails)
- Provide staging API token or greenlight for temporary tokens + IPs to add to the allowlist
- If you want SSO set up during Day 1, please share SAML metadata or Okta org name by 17 Sep

Marissa — can you be backup on Day 2 in case Ben needs to hop to another customer?

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enablement Program Manager, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.inference
Attach: API_onboarding_playbook_v1.1.pdf
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@kestrelpay.com>

Date: Wed, 11 Sep 2024 07:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: KestrelPay enablement — console + API deep-dive

Thanks all — Option A/Wednesday & Thursday works better for us (we're in BST). A few updates: 
- Confirmed attendees: Liam O'Connor (Head of Integrations), Sana Iqbal (Platform PM), Tomasz Nowak (backend), Aisha Mendes (backend) — will send full list + emails by EOD Thu 12 Sep.
- We prefer SSO demo earlier in the Day 1 console block (great to see SAML flow before admin tasks).
- For the API lab we'll provide a staging token by Mon 16 Sep. If anything slips we'll opt for the temporary token route and add Redwood IPs to our allowlist.
- Small ask: can you move the SSO demo to the first 20 minutes of Day 1? That helps our security team.

Also, quick procurement note: we'll need an invoice with PO line referencing deal HS-84321 so finance can attach it to the internal raise — happy to loop procurement if Redwood needs PO details.

Appreciate the quick coordination — we'll confirm names tomorrow.

Best,
Liam
